meta.name: Fully Open Humanoid v2 (K1 derivative)
meta.basis: ROBOTIS AI Sapiens K1 rev 1 description, kept as published; actuators, electronics, hands and covers substituted

k1.name: ROBOTIS AI Sapiens K1 (rev 1)
k1.battery: 46.8 V, 9000 mAh (published for the K0 generation)
k1.price_note: announced at 'mid-to-low 10 million KRW'; the DYNAMIXEL-Q actuators themselves are listed for Q1 2027 without a price
sources: AI Sapiens open source resources and licences
Launch coverage with the price range

rows.description: RobStride RS06 (36 N·m peak)
rows.notes: Joints: ankle_pitch, hip_pitch, hip_roll, hip_yaw, knee, waist_yaw

rows.description: RobStride RS02 (17 N·m peak)
rows.notes: Joints: ankle_roll, elbow, shoulder_pitch, shoulder_roll, shoulder_yaw, wrist_roll

sections.title: Electronics
sections.blurb: Our v1 electronics in place of the K1's: an N100 mini PC instead of the Jetson Orin NX 16 GB (the published policies are ONNX files a CPU runs at control rate), four CAN buses instead of the RS-485 bus, two 6S packs for the K1's 46.8 V pack. The K1's camera set is not published; the RealSense stays optional.

rows.description: Mini PC, Intel N100, 16 GB RAM, 500 GB SSD
rows.notes: Runs the 50 Hz policy and the 500 Hz motor loop. No GPU needed on the robot.

rows.description: USB 9-axis AHRS IMU (SYD Dynamics TM171 or equivalent)
rows.notes: Mounted rigidly to the torso bottom plate, axes aligned with the base frame.

rows.description: CANable PRO V2.0 USB-CAN adapter
rows.notes: One per bus: left leg, right leg, left arm, right arm.

rows.description: USB 3 hub, 4 port, powered
LiPo 6S 8000 mAh 100C, EC5
rows.notes: Two in series: 44.4 V nominal, 50.4 V full. Zeee or equivalent.

rows.description: 48 V to 12 V buck converter, 10 A, encased
rows.notes: Feeds the computer, the hub and the hand servos.

rows.description: Power distribution block with 60 A fuse
rows.notes: 48 V bus and ground bars; ANL/MIDI fuse on the pack lead.

rows.description: DC circuit breaker, 100 A, panel mount
rows.notes: Main disconnect and pack over-current protection.

rows.description: DC contactor, 100 A, 12 V coil
rows.notes: Switched by the E-stop loop; carries the motor bus.

rows.description: E-stop, 22 mm mushroom, NC contact
rows.notes: Opens the 48 V bus contactor coil. Duke V2 shipped without one; do not.

rows.description: TVS diode, 53 V working / 85 V clamping (1.5KE62CA)
LiPo voltage alarm, 1-8S
Blade fuse holder + 10 A fuse

sections.title: Harness
sections.blurb: Every limb is a daisy chain of XT30(2+2) drops; the tubes carry the loom inside them.

rows.description: Amass XT30(2+2)-F cable-side connector
EC5 connector pair
18 AWG silicone wire, red + black, 12 m each
rows.notes: Actuator drops; the longer legs need 2 m more than v0.2.

rows.description: 12 AWG silicone wire, red + black, 3 m each
Ethernet cable, 12 m (twisted pairs for CAN)
120 Ω resistors, 1/4 W
Heat-shrink assortment
Braided loom, 6 mm and 10 mm, 6 m each
USB-A to USB-C cables, 0.5 m and 1.5 m
rows.notes: Hub to CAN adapters, IMU, and one per arm for the hand servo board.

sections.title: Hands
sections.blurb: The K1's hands are passive rubber hands; their mesh is published, so they print in TPU.

rows.description: K1 rubber hand, printed in TPU 95A from the published mesh (pair)
rows.notes: About 738 g the pair in the K1 model.

sections.title: Structure and covers
sections.blurb: The K1 skin printed as 1.6 mm PLA shells from the published link meshes, about 2.8 kg by convex-hull area; the aluminium frame kept where the drawings show it carrying the leg loads and printed in PETG-CF elsewhere. Until ROBOTIS publishes the STEP files and BOM, the frame is a placeholder figure.

rows.description: PLA filament for the shells, 1 kg spool
rows.notes: 35 % for supports and failed prints.

rows.description: PETG-CF filament for printed brackets, 1 kg spool
rows.notes: Estimate: the actuator cups and brackets of our joint kits, re-made to the K1's joint positions.

rows.description: Aluminium frame parts kept from the K1 (laser-cut plates, extrusion)
rows.notes: Placeholder estimate until the K1 STEP files are published; the drawings give dimensions only.

rows.description: Bearings, screws, inserts, dowels, threadlocker
rows.notes: Our v1 hardware section's figure, pending the K1 BOM.

rows.description: RobStride RS03 (60 N·m peak)
rows.notes: Joints: ankle_pitch, hip_pitch, hip_roll, hip_yaw, knee, waist_yaw

rows.description: RobStride RS06 (36 N·m peak)
rows.notes: Joints: ankle_roll, elbow, shoulder_pitch, shoulder_roll, shoulder_yaw, wrist_roll
